title: Keep Tarium projects independently usable from public inputs
abstract: Ensure a Tarium project's core operation and documented setup can use its own public assets or expressly documented publicly accessible dependencies, without requiring private Taria workspaces, secret services or unpublished resources.

scope_hints.scope_boundary: Only explicitly authorized work on independent public Tarium projects

remarks: Public-source rule normalization reviewed as a distinct project-specific atom; overlapping general rules retained.
